title: Deterministic context inventory first
summary: Add a repeatable inventory before rewriting skills so budgets and deltas are measurable.

title: Skill kernels plus one-level references
summary: Refactor high-use skills into compact kernels with low-frequency detail in one-level references.

title: AGENTS.md locality with lint-clean child rules
summary: Keep root AGENTS.md project-wide and audit child AGENTS.md files such as skills/AGENTS.md for locality, lint, and budget.

title: State-aware resume primer
summary: Emit a compact resume primer from state, receipts, and context packs instead of historical narrative or full skill reinjection.

title: Tool/schema overhead audit before tool architecture changes
summary: Measure wrapper/tool schema overhead by phase before introducing active-tool profiles or deferred discovery.

title: Behavior-preserving phased migration
summary: Migrate one context source at a time with validation after each split and a ledger for moved or removed rules.

title: Skill-only split
summary: Move details out of SKILL.md files but leave compaction/resume and tools unchanged.

title: Tooling-first resume only
summary: Focus on state/transition resume primers and avoid skill edits.

title: Aggressive deferred tool loading first
summary: Implement active-tool profiles or deferred discovery before shrinking skills.

title: Hybrid phased migration
summary: Combine inventory, skill kernels, AGENTS.md locality, resume primer, and measured tool/schema reduction.
infrastructure_only_rationale: Accepted alternative node documents the selected design approach across decisions; individual decisions satisfy requirements.

title: Context inventory script or wrapper mode
summary: Reports context size budgets and deltas for AGENTS.md files, skills, compaction/resume, and tools.

title: Compact skill kernels and one-level references
summary: Holds concise workflow kernels and load-on-demand reference files.

title: AGENTS.md hierarchy budget checks
summary: Keeps root and child AGENTS.md files local, compact, and lint-clean.

title: State-resume primer tooling
summary: Builds compact resume context from state, receipts, and context packs.

title: Tool/schema inventory and profiles
summary: Measures and optionally reduces active tool/schema context by workflow phase.

title: Rule loss during skill splitting
summary: Rules may be lost when large skill prose moves into references or tooling.
mitigation: Rule relocation ledger, one-skill-at-a-time validation, auditor gate.

title: References become hard to discover
summary: Agents may fail to find needed details after skill content is split.
mitigation: Kernels name exact reference files and trigger conditions.

title: Resume primer omits critical blocker
summary: A short resume primer could omit the next blocker or required validation context.
mitigation: Include validation receipts, blockers, next action, and context-pack references.

title: Tool-schema reduction hides guardrails
summary: Reducing active tool exposure may hide required validation or mutation wrappers.
mitigation: Inventory first; preserve wrapper tools until measured design supports reduction.

title: Context bloat audit testing strategy
summary: Use inventory tests, skill reference checks, resume-primer tests, workflow dry-runs, and manual-assisted E2E smoke evidence.
